body.message:
Hi! I’m looking for an apartment in Dubai from around October 10–15 for an initial period of 3 months, with the possibility of extending the lease afterwards.

Preferred areas:
• Business Bay
• Dubai Marina
• Or nearby areas with good infrastructure and convenient access to the metro

Budget: AED 4,000–6,500 per month.

I’m looking for a 1-bedroom apartment or a well-planned studio. The main requirement is that the sleeping area is separated from the kitchen/living area — ideally a proper bedroom, or a studio with a smart layout that provides enough privacy.

I’m mainly looking for the best value for money, so I’d appreciate it if you could share your best options in terms of price, quality, location, and overall value.

Please let me know if you have any suitable options available. Thank you!
